title: Local Data and Persistence

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Local Data and Persistence** as part of **Kotlin for Android Development**. Integration code must validate external data, handle timeouts and failure states, keep credentials outside source control, and test boundary behavior. Use the subtopics—Preferences and Key-Value Storage, Room Database Fundamentals, Offline-First Data Concepts—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Android code must account for lifecycle changes, accessibility, UI state, and platform APIs. Isolating business logic makes the interface easier to test.
